title: Night-flow checks after pipe repairs
titleZh: 管線修繕後的夜間流量檢查
passage:
FIELD OPERATIONS | Night-flow checks after pipe repairs

At each site, note the flow shown on the street meter once the repair crew has closed the test outlet. Take another reading ten minutes later. If the two readings differ, take a third ten minutes after the second. The aim is to see whether the flow has settled, not to record the highest number seen that night. Use the last two readings, and enter a result only if they match. Otherwise, write “unsettled” in the result box rather than entering a number.

Record any legitimate water use reported by the site contact during the check. For example, if a caretaker says the grounds were watered then, add that detail as a note. The duty officer needs to know about planned use before deciding whether to send a leak crew. Do not subtract your own estimate of how much water was used.

Dispatch decisions are made from the shared log at dawn. If the meter display is blank, enter “display fault” in the equipment column. Leave the result box empty in that case; “unsettled” is for checks with actual readings. If water is visibly running onto the road, call the duty officer right away regardless of the meter result. This call is in addition to the log entry, not in place of it.
passageZh:
現場作業｜管線修繕後的夜間流量檢查

每到一處，請等維修人員關閉測試出水口，再記下街道流量計的讀值。十分鐘後再量一次。若兩次讀值不同，請在第二次讀值十分鐘後再量第三次。目的是看流量是否穩定，不是記錄當晚觀察到的最高值。請採用最後兩次讀值，只有兩次相同才將數值填入結果欄。否則，請在結果欄填「未穩定」，不要填數字。

如場地聯絡人在檢查期間告知有正常用水情形，請記錄。例如，若管理員說當時有澆灌場地，就把這件事寫入備註。值班主管在決定是否派人查漏之前，需要知道有計畫性的用水。不要自行估算用水量後從讀值中扣除。

調度人員會在清晨依共用紀錄決定如何派工。如果流量計的螢幕沒有顯示，請在設備欄寫「顯示故障」。這時把結果欄留空；有實際讀值的檢查才可能標示為「未穩定」。如果明顯看到有水流到路面，不管流量計結果如何，都要立即致電值班主管。打電話之外仍要填寫紀錄，不能只打電話。
